newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile shares end at year low amid technical trade.
newsitem.headline: Chile shares end at year low amid technical trade.

text.p: Chilean blue chips sank 1.32 percent on Friday to close at a year low amid trading by local investors motivated by technical factors, traders said.
The declines are expected to continue next week, they said.
"I expect it to continue soft next week as there's no news to haul stocks out of the current rut," a dealer said.
The 40-share IPSA index ended down 1.32 percent at 89.14 points. The general IGPA index shed 0.99 percent to 4,909.69 points.
